3f:["$","li","standards_alignment",{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":["Standards alignment",": ","2.2"]}],["$","div",null,{"className":"small","children":["Anchor 2: one current third-party attestation with a confirmed scope, the CSA STAR Level 2 certification of Redis Cloud in the public registry.
